**Maps come from a list on the site.** The mod downloads `maps.json` (kept in a cache) with each map's territories file, dynmap world, dimension and, optionally, server address, so a new world or server is a line in that file and not a new version of the mod. The built-in Gaia and Cumania IV remain as the fallback. New commands: `/territories maps` lists them and `/territories discover` shows the dynmap world, dimension and server address to fill in a new entry. In Auto, a server the list names picks its map when you join. (For Minecraft 26.1.x, 26.2 and 26.3.)
